material_model.type: hypothetical uniform one-dimensional linear elastic free-end slender rod quasi-statically balancing tidal differential acceleration in an E=1 Schwarzschild reference freefall frame
material_model.equilibrium_stress_profile: sigma(x)=rho*lambda*(L²/8 − x²/2), x from -L/2 to L/2, sigma(±L/2)=0
material_model.applicability: wave/tide<=0.1, L/min(r,sqrt(r³/rs))<=0.01, sigma<assumed yield and radius before classical K*lp^4 stop

kerr_model.chi_definition: cJ/(G M²), assumed not measured for Sgr A* in this model
kerr_model.r_plus: r_g(1+sqrt(1−chi²)) Boyer-Lindquist coordinate; NOT areal radius
kerr_model.isco: Bardeen Press Teukolsky equatorial prograde and retrograde circular orbit radii
kerr_model.reason_missing: A compatible Kerr geodesic and a specified local falling tetrad are required to calculate observer-dependent electric tidal tensor; not inferred from Kerr horizon or from Schwarzschild formulas.
kerr_model.equatorial_Kretschmann_fact: At equatorial Boyer-Lindquist r the Kerr Kretschmann scalar reduces to 48r_g²/r⁶ independent of chi; this is NOT spin independence of observer measured tidal eigenvalues.

executed_tests.mock_browser_ui: PASS horizon, steel/aluminum first gates, spins 0 and .99, 24factorial seam, invalid rank guard

limitations: Thresholds are illustrative and NOT a tested material, measured failure point or physical singularity.
Quasi-static rod equilibrium neglects dynamic stress-wave propagation once wave/tidal timescale ratio is large.
Poisson coupling, plasticity, fractures, temperature, shock and material anisotropy are not modeled.
Kerr metric spin is hypothetical and no matching freely falling Kerr observer/tetrad or material stress was computed.
Schwarzschild and Kerr Boyer-Lindquist coordinate radii are not to be treated as identical physical areal radii.
24! and the 729 logarithmic registry remain independent logical selectors; no celestial matter is transported by address changes.
Historical Bounds 01-12, including red giant / HI tracer residuals, were not modified.
next_boundary: Bound 14: specify Kerr geodesic E,L_z,Q and construct parallel transported local tetrad to calculate actual Kerr electric/magnetic tidal tensors; separately, dynamic finite-element/elastic-wave rod evolution.
